notes_for_editor: Tower year: 1934 on three pages (Forest Lookouts entry, Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com) vs 1937 in the register, which dates the cabin and tower together. Tower end: destroyed or gone in 1977 (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com) vs removed in 1981 (register); the Forest Lookouts entry gives no date. Cabin date: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both tie a log cabin to 1929; the register dates the cabin to 1937. Current condition conflicts: register and firelookout.com say the platform and cabin remain, Idaho Fire Lookouts says destroyed, FFLOS says standing; none is dated. The record status 'gone' fits the tower but not the reported cabin and platform; a human should decide whether to change the status. Record coordinates (45.50046, -115.38457) match no source and sit about 29 km from the register and FFLOS points. A University of Idaho archive photo dated September 9, 1951 surfaced in search and was not opened or cited. Facebook posts from the Payette National Forest and the FFLA were not read.
